mail-sending-done-own: Replies go out from {{address}} once its domain is verified.

mail-sending-sender-default-description: Replies leave from this inbox's own address. Nothing to set up, and you can move to your own domain later.
mail-sending-cloudflare-unavailable: This workspace has no way to send yet, so add a sending domain first.

mail-sending-required-cloudflare-descrip: Mail arrives and leaves on your domain, with no forwarding. Needs a Workers Paid plan.
mail-sending-required-provider-descripti: Mail arrives at an erxes address by forwarding and leaves from your domain. Publish the records it gives you — your nameservers stay where they are.

no-comment-replies: This bot has not replied to a comment yet.

comment-no-result: No result came back within the hour, so the automation stopped waiting. The bot’s Activity tab says whether the reply went out.
comment-post-limit-reached: Skipped: this post already received {{limit}} public replies. The private reply still went out.
